title: Eighteenmile Creek: four stream nutrient stations, 2020–2025
issuing_body: South Carolina Department of Environmental Services, original WQP records
observation_scope: Original stream observations with separate constituent, fraction, method, result-type and unit series. All four stations are inside the retained whole basin; gauge-specific upstream applicability is unassigned.

source_interpretation.native_model_context: Dated stream concentration context alongside separately retained native watershed model outputs.
source_interpretation.coordinates: Original WGS84 station coordinates; EPSG:4326. Original unsplit NLDI basin supplies whole-basin context.
source_interpretation.temporal_support: Original sampling dates. Calendar filters select observations; complete agency responses remain unchanged.
